title: Salesforce Data Migration Specialist
description:
About Us :

Kelley Austin takes a different approach to Salesforce Consulting by putting our employees first. That’s not hyperbole, either. Our team takes a proactive approach to employee satisfaction by having every single person fill out a “happiness list,” which comprises the top ten things each employee finds happiness in outside of work.

We review those happiness lists regularly to ensure everyone is checking most of the boxes and adjust their project load, responsibilities, or schedule accordingly if not.

Look at our benefits and perks below to learn more about our culture.

We’re growing fast (more than doubling YOY) but staying diligent in hiring the best possible people who don’t just want a job, but will actually care about the success of their co-workers and clients.

Our growth, coupled with the distinction of being recognized as the 'fastest Salesforce Implementation Partner to achieve Platinum / Summit status,' attests to the success of our approach.

Take a look at the ‘About You’ and ‘Responsibilities’ below to learn more :

Benefits

  • Base Salary
  • Work From Home Flexibility
  • Flexible PTO (we treat people like adults here)
  • Paid Holidays (including an entire week off around Christmas and New Year)

Tools We Use

  • As a technology software consulting company, we use many tools, but the big four are Google Drive, Slack, Lucid Chart, and Salesforce, of course.

Perks Of The Job

  • You won’t really find egos here. We hire slowly and purposefully to keep our culture strong and our team cohesive.
  • We don’t say yes to every client and are not afraid to part ways with a client, either. If there’s no mutual respect or success involved, we politely decline and help them find a different partner. That means fewer ‘tough’ clients and more clients who “get it” and work harmoniously together.
  • We offer half a dozen different clubs like book club, health club, movie club, hobby club, and more. These bring people together to grow intellectually and get to know one another outside of project work.
  • We work an average of 40 hours per week (I know, that’s unheard of in consulting, but we stand by it).

About You

We are seeking a Data Migration Specialist with deep hands-on expertise in Salesforce, Salesforce SOQL, Salesforce APEX, relational databases, SQL, scripting, and large-scale data migration. This role is highly execution-focused and detail-oriented — you will be designing and running ETL processes, writing queries and scripts, validating data quality, and ensuring successful end-to-end migrations between enterprise systems.

Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and manage end-to-end data migration projects, including extraction, transformation, loading, and validation.
  • Write and optimize complex SQL and SOQL queries for data validation, migration, and reconciliation.
  • Build, configure, and run ETL jobs to move and transform data across Salesforce, ERP, and external databases.
  • Develop and maintain automation scripts (APEX, Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar) for data processing, cleansing, and quality checks.
  • Perform data profiling, mapping, and transformation to meet business and technical requirements.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve migration issues such as data mismatches, performance bottlenecks, and integrity errors.
  • Collaborate with internal and external Salesforce, integration, and business teams to coordinate cutovers and validate migrated data.
  • Document migration procedures, scripts, mappings, and reconciliation steps for repeatability and compliance.
  • Ensure all migrations follow best practices for data quality, security, and governance.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field (or equivalent hands-on experience).
  • 5+ years of direct experience in data migration, ETL, or database engineering roles.
  • Strong technical expertise in relational databases (Salesforce, Oracle, SQL Server, or similar).
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL (query optimization, joins, stored procedures).
  • Practical experience with Salesforce SOQL, APEX, and Salesforce data model.
  • Proven track record in data migration projects, including reconciliation and cutover planning.
  • Hands-on scripting skills in Python, Shell, PowerShell, or similar.
  • Familiarity with ETL tools, APIs, and bulk data processing.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to deliver under tight deadlines.

NOTE : Kelley Austin will not be able to sponsor applicants for work visas.

  8. Priorizar e acompanhar a resolução de problemas junto à equipe de desenvolvimento.
  9. Fornecer feedback contínuo sobre a qualidade do código e a eficácia das correções.

Requisitos e qualificações

O que amplia as suas chances:

  • Seu fit cultural.

O que não pode faltar:

  • Experiência de pelo menos 3 anos como Analista de QA ou cargos relacionados.
  • Conhecimento sólido em testes de software, incluindo testes funcionais, de regressão, de carga e de performance.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de automação de testes.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e práticas de DevOps.
  • Habilidades analíticas e atenção aos detalhes para identificar problemas e áreas de melhoria.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa em equipes multidisciplinares.

Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de CI/CD (ex.: Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Experiência com ambientes de nuvem (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

  • Technical Enablement: Provide technical support and guidance on platform features, best practices, and optimizations to improve client operations.
  • Client Engagement & Expansion: Build strong relationships with clients, including C-Level executives, to identify growth opportunities, negotiate renewals, and promote upsells.

Weni by VTEX is a business unit of VTEX dedicated to enterprise customer experience solutions powered by artificial intelligence, designed for brands and retailers.

With the Weni Platform, we redefine sales and post-sales journeys through hyperautomation and the smart integration of data into conversational channels, delivering faster, more personalized, and more efficient experiences for consumers.

title: Business Services Team Manager
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few roles based in offices.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Business Services Team Manager to lead efficient and effective travel, logistics, event, scheduling, expense policy and administration.

This executive role requires outstanding coordination, planning, decision-making, budgeting, procurement, reporting and management. It is a fast-paced and complex operation in the tech industry.

We coordinate large-scale company events which involve travel for hundreds of people from 80+ countries. We run such events four times a year, a significant investment in our ability to shape culture, teamwork, execution plans and strategy. Our team is responsible for travel procurement and logistics, ensuring that these events run efficiently and safely. Visas, travel complications and unexpected situations make this a complex operation to run efficiently, demanding a rigorous approach and high work ethic in the team.

This team also serves as an independent check on expense claim approval, ensuring fairness and consistency across teams and countries. This requires integrity, transparency and accountability, and a willingness to set and politely defend the same expectations of the most senior and most junior colleagues.

Together these responsibilities amount to tens of millions in operational costs and a significant number of tactical and operational decisions.

Our team also provides traditional 'EA' services for company leads, though they do this across departments and as a consistent service rather than as personal assistants; they schedule meetings, coordinate monthly reports, handle delegated approvals for travel and expenses, work across teams, coordinate with suppliers, and run small projects or initiatives.

Location: Worldwide, home based, except in locations where we have an office, such as London, Taipei and Beijing

Leadership and accountability

This team has a direct impact on every team at Canonical. It is important for them to have excellent judgment and interpersonal skills, the confidence to hold people accountable and defend positions of policy, and the work ethic to move quickly through a large volume of work. It is also essential that the team participate in every company event, from the planning and venue selection stages to scheduling, operations and safety reviews, to ensure that they establish personal relationships with team leaders and can ensure that these events run smoothly.

As a manager, your team would be responsible for

  • Travel approvals, logistics and operations
  • Expense review in line with policies
  • Planning of complex company events four times a year
  • Company offices that provide executive briefing and operational facilities
  • Our global duty of care, health and safety programs with comprehensive policies and practices

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • An undergraduate degree in a technical or business subject
  • Drive, and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Leadership and management skills
  • Demonstrable good judgement in matters involving money, policy and in-person interactions
  • Ability to work in a global, multicultural organisation
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility
  • Responsibility, accountability, thoughtfulness and self-awareness
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments
  • Ability to travel up to four times a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Travel industry experience
  • Project management experience
  • Event management and operations experience
  • Business and corporate administration experience

What we offer you

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer.

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Sales and Market Development Specialist, Custom
description:
Overview

The Custom Sales Specialist is responsible for driving revenue growth of custom products while maintaining a focus on bottom-line financial results. A major responsibility of the job will be training, strategizing, and collaborating with college sales representatives, sales managers, and other marketing specialists on winning new custom business. The Custom Sales Specialist will develop relationships with potential customers, serve as content expert across all disciplines, and implement strategies for winning new market share and retaining existing business. This position requires a person with demonstrated sales skills to work with reps, demonstrate strategic selling, build customer relationships, and close business. A proactive, analytical, and solution-focused approach to identifying and fulfilling customer needs is essential. Excellent presentation skills are a must, and specialists are expected to travel roughly 30% of the time during the academic year. An ideal candidate will be an enthusiastic salesperson who creatively solves problems while maintaining a focus on bottom-line results and managing logistical details.

Responsibilities

  • Campus visits focused on helping sales representatives to sell custom across all disciplines with a focus on winning new business. This job requires about 30% travel, covering all of the United States (and occasionally Canada)
  • Prepare and conduct on-campus or virtual presentations
  • Respond to Salesforce opportunities in which custom has been identified as a consideration with strategic guidance and drive Salesforce activity from the field by identifying potential custom business to target
  • Act as content expert across all disciplines
  • Collaborate and communicate regularly with other marketing specialists on effective strategies for winning new custom business
  • When applicable, draft sales proposals for new custom adoptions and/or contribute to service agreements for custom adoptions
  • Negotiate custom pricing and create custom P&Ls with an eye toward hitting minimum benchmarks for profitability
  • When applicable, negotiate royalties for content supplied by custom adopters and coordinate contracts for these custom adoptions
  • Act as the initial liaison between new custom adopters, college sales reps, bookstores, and the custom editorial and production teams, ensuring that all appropriate details (for example, ISBNs) are being managed and communicated effectively. This includes participating in launch meetings for all new complex custom projects and helping ensure that all deadlines and deliverables are met
  • Serve as a main point of contact and service for custom adopters when necessary
  • Providing feedback to senior management on market demand and optimizing Norton\'s custom strategy
  • Providing feedback to the custom team leadership about market demand and suggest improvements to existing process management
  • Other miscellaneous projects that come up and other detailed responsibilities not listed above

Experience and Skills

  • Strong work ethic and attention to detail
  • Curious and creative
  • Competitive and collaborative
  • Positive and empathetic

Requirements and Skills

  • Bachelor\'s Degree
  • 3 years of proven experience in higher education publishing sales preferred, 3 years of successful sales experience required
  • Must be highly disciplined and self-motivated
  • Must be collaborative and enjoy working on a team
  • Must be organized, detail-oriented, and responsive
  • Must be a creative, solutions-focused problem solver
  • Must have the ability to strategize to win prospective business
  • Must be able to effectively support reps on campus
  • Must develop content knowledge in all discipline areas
  • Must have superior verbal and written communications.
  • Excellent presentation skills are required
  • Must have the ability to multi-task and effectively prioritize, both when working on the fulfillment and delivery of custom products, but also tracking the progress of potential adoptions across an academic year
  • Must be willing to travel approximately 30% of the time during the academic sales year, with more travel possible during peak presentation and adoption periods
  • Employment eligibility to work with W.W. Norton & Company in the US is required
  • Must be able to work full business hours

Benefits

  • Annual compensation for this position is $60,000-$80,000. This position is eligible for discretionary annual bonuses. All salaries and salary ranges posted by Norton may vary depending on experience, skills, location, and like considerations.
  • Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and summer Friday afternoons beginning in July
  • Generous health benefits, including PPO, EPO, and High Deductible (with HSA) medical insurance options, vision insurance, dental insurance, flexible spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care and commuter, gym membership reimbursement, and more. Coverage for spouses, domestic partners, and dependent children is available.
  • Profit-Sharing and 401(k) benefit plan with discretionary contribution matching by employer
  • Disability and life insurances
  • FMLA, parental, and other leave
  • Employee Assistance Program (for mental health, financial planning, and other needs)
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Employee discounts on Norton books
  • Limited matching of employee donations to select non-profit organizations

*All policies and benefits described are subject to change at any time.

description:

A NOVA nasceu para ser DISRUPTIVA: mostrar que uma agência 100% Remote-First pode entregar resultados melhores que qualquer operação presencial.

Cultura NOVA = Alta exigência + aprendizado constante + crescimento rápido

Zero espaço para mediocridade. Excelência radical & atenção obsessiva aos detalhes – qualidade acima de tudo. Prazos são lei – planejamento firme, entrega no horário, zero desculpas. Feedback direto e objetivo – problemas são resolvidos sem rodeios. Compromisso com resultados.

Processo relâmpago / Início Imediato.

Envie CV + deck de case/portfólio (antes & depois, números) por email até 30/05. Em um documento à parte, no mesmo email, responda às perguntas:

  • Quando você cria a copy de uma página de vendas ou landing page, quais elementos considera essenciais para gerar conversão?
  • Ao criar conteúdos para redes sociais, como você decide o formato ideal (post, reels, carrossel), frequência e copy?
  • Quando um conteúdo não performa como esperado, quais dados você analisa primeiro e como decide se ajusta ou mantém a estratégia?

Etapas subsequentes: triagem (24h) → entrevista com recrutador → entrevista com founders → desafio prático → oferta.

Somos mais de 4.000 profissionais em 11 países, cultivando uma cultura de startup multicultural que promove inovação e aprendizado contínuo para criar soluções de alto valor para nossos clientes.

Procuramos por Consultor SAP PS/PM, para atuação 100% remota.

Principais Responsabilidades e Requisitos:

  • Experiência nos módulos SAP PS e PM.
  • Conhecimento e atuação na área de energia e utilidades nos módulos PS e PM.
  • Experiência em Projetos de Melhorias e AMS com ferramenta de atendimento de chamados.
  • Facilidade e vivência na comunicação com a área de negócio.
  • Conhecimento nas integrações dos módulos PS e PM com principalmente MM, CO, FI e AA.

Benefícios:

  • Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação: Benefícios mensais para suas despesas com alimentação, dentro e fora de casa.
  • Previdência Privada: Planejamento de futuro com contribuição complementar à aposentadoria.
  • Plano de Saúde: Cobertura médica de alta qualidade para você e seu dependente legal.
  • Seguro de Vida: Proteção e segurança para você e seus entes queridos.
  • Aulas de Inglês/Espanhol: Incentivo ao aprendizado de idiomas.
  • Wellhub: Benefícios e descontos em academias e programas de bem-estar.
  • Auxílio Creche: Suporte financeiro para despesas com educação infantil.
  • Neoris Global Campus: Plataforma de desenvolvimento com oportunidades contínuas de aprendizado e crescimento profissional.

Saiba mais em , Facebook, LinkedIn, Twitter ou Instagram: @NEORIS.

Candidatar-se a esta vaga

Por favor, preencha os campos obrigatórios, incluindo URL do perfil do LinkedIn, modelo de trabalho desejado, e local de residência.

Convidamos os candidatos a compartilhar seus antecedentes demográficos. Suas respostas podem ajudar a identificar áreas de melhoria no nosso processo de contratação.

title: Coordenador De Marketing Hands-On (Remoto)
description:
Overview


Desculpe, a oferta não está disponível, mas você pode realizar uma nova pesquisa ou explorar ofertas semelhantes:



Requisitos


Escolaridade: Curso Superior - Graduação - Completo
PCD: Não
Contratação: CLT
Benefícios: Vale-refeição, Vale-transporte



Descrição da vaga


Descrição: Vaga de Analista de Marketing. A vaga envolve o apoio na tomada de decisão e execução da estratégia de conteúdo da empresa.



Atribuições



  • Ajudar na criação de campanhas publicitárias ou promocionais

  • Promover ações de lançamentos de produtos ou serviços

  • Providenciar pesquisas



Sobre a empresa e benefícios


A NOVA nasceu para ser DISRUPTIVA: mostrar que uma agência 100 % Remote-First pode entregar resultados melhores que qualquer operação presencial.



Por que essa vaga é diferente?



  • Impacto imediato: você tocará a estratégia 360° de contas nacionais e internacionais, sendo o \"mini-CMO\" do time.

  • Salário competitivo + bônus por resultado (faixa discutida na 1ª etapa).

  • Trilha rápida para Gerente de Marketing (12-24 meses, de acordo com a performance).

  • Agência enxuta e em escala — suas ideias saem do papel em dias, não em meses.



O que você vai fazer (mãos na massa + liderança)



  1. Planejar campanhas (conteúdo, mídia paga, automação) com OKRs claros.

  2. Desenhar e otimizar funis completos (atração, nutrição, conversão), integrando social, anúncios, e-mail e outros.

  3. Garantir performance: ROAS, CAC, crescimento orgânico e NPS do cliente.

  4. Exigir padrão estético impecável (design, copy, vídeo).

  5. Ser ponte sênior com o cliente: monthly review, relatórios insights-driven.

  6. Liderar o squad: distribuir tarefas, remover impedimentos, acompanhar de perto a produção.

  7. Hands-on sempre que preciso (copy, segmentação de Ads, ajustes em LP).



Para brilhar aqui, você precisa



  • 6+ anos em marketing digital com cases comprovados (ex.: ROAS = 3, CAC reduzido, growth orgânico expressivo).

  • Domínio real de mídia orgânica e paga (Meta / Google) e funis/automações (HubSpot, ActiveCampaign etc.).

  • Copywriting persuasivo + leitura ninja de dados (GA4, UTMs, dashboards).

  • Visão T-shaped: entende de social, design, funil, analytics e quer aprender sempre.

  • Energia de dono(a): resolve, prioriza, decide.

  • Inglês fluente.



Diferenciais



  • SEO on-page, Webflow/WordPress básico.

  • Gestão de orçamentos > R$ 100 k/mês.

  • Certificações Meta/Google/HubSpot.



Cultura NOVA


Alta exigência + aprendizado constante + crescimento rápido. Zero espaço para mediocridade. Excelência radical e atenção obsessiva aos detalhes – qualidade acima de tudo. Prazos são lei – planejamento firme, entrega no horário, zero desculpas. Feedback direto e objetivo – problemas são resolvidos sem rodeios. Compromisso com resultados.



Processo de seleção


Processo relâmpago / Início Imediato



Como se candidatar


Envie CV + deck de case/portfolio (antes & depois, números) por email até 30/05. Em um documento à parte, no mesmo email, responda às perguntas:



  • Quando você cria a copy de uma página de vendas ou landing page, quais elementos considera essenciais para gerar conversão?

  • Ao criar conteúdos para redes sociais, como você decide o formato ideal (post, reels, carrossel), frequência e copy?

  • Quando um conteúdo não performa como esperado, quais dados você analisa primeiro e como decide se ajusta ou mantém a estratégia?



Etapas subsequentes



  1. Triagem (24 h)

  2. Entrevista com recrutador

  3. Entrevista com founders

  4. Desafio prático

  5. Oferta



Encerramento


Pronto para crescer com a gente?


Envie seu material com o assunto \"Coordenador(a) de Marketing — NOME E SOBRENOME\".



NOVA Agência de Marketing
